result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major layout problem where horizontally scrollable content is clipped at the right edge without clear affordance, and a minor content truncation issue in the 'Popular right now' section.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel clips the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') at the right screen edge, and the category filter chips row is also cut off mid-chip on the right. While this can indicate scrollability, there is no visual cue (fade gradient, peek spacing, or scroll indicator) and the card text is truncated awkwardly.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge fade gradient or ensure consistent card peek spacing to signal horizontal scrolling, and verify the carousel scrolls smoothly without clipping text mid-word.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' is truncated to 'Tokumaru Rameı' / 'Tokumaru Rame' with the final letter cut off at the container boundary in the 'Popular right now' card.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to a second line or apply a proper ellipsis (…) instead of hard-clipping the last character.
